_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

invest_m.basis: millions of dollars Lockheed says it is investing at Grand Prairie

footprint_sqft.basis: square feet the manufacturing footprint expands to, more than

office_sqft.basis: square feet of office space turned to manufacturing

cell_year.basis: year the cell is expected to be operational, early

jobs_us.basis: jobs Lockheed plans across the United States, its own figure

jobs_tx.basis: of those, jobs in Texas, its own figure

added_machines.basis: high precision machines installed in a few months, more than

machines_by_2026.basis: new advanced machines expected by the end of 2026, nearly

parts_year.basis: the year of the parts count

agreement_years.basis: years in the Lockheed and Hadrian agreement, the quote's 'seven'

facilities_us.basis: facilities Lockheed says it will modernize or expand, more than

tech_days.basis: days Hadrian says it trains a factory technician in, or less

pac3_produced.basis: PAC-3 MSEs produced, more than, per the PAC-3 page

cell_share_of_new_pct.basis: the cell's 24 machines as a share of the nearly 100 expected by end of 2026, rounded half up to a whole percent; drawn, never printed

parts_per_employee.basis: 250,000 parts over nearly 800 employees, floored to a whole part, and the 800 is a nearly; drawn, never printed
